definition.name: NXoperando_monopd

symbols.doc: Symbols used in dimension declarations. Each symbol binds within a single group instance: nP may differ between scan subentries and nE between electrochemistry series.

symbol.name: nP
symbol.doc: Number of points in one azimuthally averaged 1D diffraction pattern.

symbol.name: nE
symbol.doc: Number of points in one electrochemistry time series.

definition.doc: Application definition for operando powder diffraction of electrochemical cells with a monochromatic X-ray or neutron source. A single entry holds the experiment-level instrument and sample description together with the full electrochemical cycling record; each diffraction acquisition is a sequentially numbered NXsubentry (scan_000001, scan_000002, ...) holding only its diffraction data and the acquisition window and electrochemical state of the cell.

attribute.name: default
attribute.doc: Name of the NXdata group to visualise first, typically operando_electrochemistry.

field.name: definition
field.doc: Official NeXus NXDL schema to which this file conforms.

group.name: process
group.doc: The single provenance record: the generating program and version, the generation date, and the parameters used to match each diffraction acquisition to the electrochemical record.

field.name: program
field.doc: Name of the generating program (operaxn).

field.name: version
field.doc: Version of the generating program.

field.name: data_source
field.doc: Origin of the diffraction data.

field.name: correlation_method
field.doc: absolute: diffraction and electrochemistry clocks are synchronised and matched on absolute timestamps. relative: streams are aligned on elapsed time (unsynchronised clocks): the first electrochemistry point is taken as simultaneous with the first scan's correlation timestamp (midpoint_adjusted_timestamp, the exposure midpoint) and every scan is matched at its elapsed time from that origin; voltage_timestamp then stays in the electrochemistry clock.

attribute.name: target
attribute.doc: HDF5 path of this group; marks it as the original that the per-scan instrument soft links point to.

group.name: edf_metadata
group.doc: Verbatim harvest of the source EDF header; exempt from validation.

group.name: synchrotron_metadata
group.doc: Verbatim harvest of the source synchrotron NeXus metadata; exempt from validation.

field.name: description
field.doc: Cell chemistry, electrode composition, cell format and fabrication details. Required in the published Figure 4; recommended here because it is human-entered and cannot be harvested from the source data. Tightening to required is deferred to the NIAC submission.

field.name: preparation_date
field.doc: Date the electrochemical cell was assembled (human-entered at upload; stored as a timezone-aware ISO 8601 timestamp).

group.name: cycling_protocol
group.doc: Human-entered description of the electrochemical cycling protocol applied during the operando experiment. Required in the published Figure 4; recommended here because none of it can be harvested from the diffraction or electrochemistry source files. Tightening to required is deferred to the NIAC submission. When the group is present, technique is required.

field.name: technique
field.doc: Electrochemical technique applied (e.g. galvanostatic cycling, GITT, CV), including any ageing protocol the cell was subjected to before the operando experiment.

field.name: voltage_window_lower
field.doc: Lower cut-off voltage of the cycling window.

field.name: voltage_window_upper
field.doc: Upper cut-off voltage of the cycling window.

field.name: C_rate
field.doc: Nominal C-rate of the cycling, as a free-text label (e.g. C/10, 1C).

field.name: instrument
field.doc: Potentiostat/galvanostat make and model used for the cycling.

field.name: software
field.doc: Control/acquisition software of the potentiostat, with version.

field.name: raw_data_file
field.doc: Name or DOI of the raw electrochemistry data file this record was taken from.

group.name: monitor
group.doc: Beam monitor record of the experiment, as in NXmonopd, held once at entry level because it is invariant over the experiment. Required in NXmonopd and Figure 4; optional here because only in-house acquisitions record one: they count to a time preset, so mode is timer and preset is the exposure every acquisition shares (absent when acquisitions differ; each acquisition's exposure is SCAN/environment/exposure_time). integral is per acquisition, in SCAN/monitor, and only on instruments with a beam monitor. Synchrotron sources record none.

field.name: mode
field.doc: Count to a preset value based on either clock time (timer) or received monitor counts (monitor).

field.name: preset
field.doc: Preset value for time (seconds) or monitor counts, shared by every acquisition.

group.name: operando_electrochemistry
group.doc: Full electrochemical cycling record of the operando experiment. Time is stored as elapsed seconds with the absolute origin in the start attribute (NXlog convention), enabling both plotting and re-correlation against the scan subentries. Required in the published Figure 4; recommended here because it is absent from diffraction-only files (no electrochemistry supplied) and present whenever an electrochemistry record was correlated.

group.name: standard_electrochemistry
group.doc: Additional electrochemistry files associated with the experiment but not time-correlated with the diffraction data (e.g. formation cycles), one NXdata group per source file.
One source file, named file_NNN (file_001, file_002, ...).

group.name: SCAN
group.doc: One group per diffraction acquisition, named scan_NNNNNN with a zero-padded sequence number (scan_000001, scan_000002, ...). It holds what varies per acquisition: the environment group (acquisition window and electrochemical state of the cell), the diffraction data and, for in-house acquisitions, the beam-monitor record from the EDF header. The measurement setup is invariant during the experiment and is described once at entry level; by convention each subentry carries an HDF5 soft link named "instrument" (with a target attribute) to /entry/instrument rather than a copy. This is documented here rather than declared as an NXDL link: links cannot be optional in the NXDL schema, and pynxtools traverses the soft link and checks its target attribute but does not match a declared link against a linked group, so declaring it would fail every conforming file.

group.name: environment
group.doc: Acquisition window and electrochemical state of the cell during this acquisition.

field.name: start_time
field.doc: Start of the acquisition (exposure start).

field.name: end_time
field.doc: End of the acquisition: start plus exposure.

field.name: voltage
field.doc: Cell voltage at the electrochemistry point nearest the midpoint-adjusted scan timestamp. Required in the published Figure 4; recommended here because it is present only when the acquisition was correlated with an electrochemistry point within the correlation tolerance, 300 s in OperaXN 2.0.0 (absent for uncorrelated scans and for diffraction-only files). The tolerance also applies beyond either end of the electrochemistry record: a scan whose correlation timestamp lies within 300 s before its first point or after its last is matched to that end point; its voltage_min/voltage_max are then absent only when the acquisition window itself holds no point.

field.name: current
field.doc: Cell current at the matched electrochemistry point. Same presence rule as voltage: written only when the scan was correlated within the correlation tolerance.

field.name: voltage_min
field.doc: Minimum cell voltage over every electrochemistry point with start_time <= t <= end_time (both bounds inclusive), in the same clock alignment as the nearest-point correlation. Required in the published Figure 4; optional here because it is absent when the window holds no point (short exposures against a sparse logging cadence) or end_time is unknown.

field.name: voltage_max
field.doc: Maximum cell voltage over the same window points; same presence rule as voltage_min.

field.name: current_min
field.doc: Minimum cell current over the same window points; as voltage_min, and also absent when no window point carries a current.

field.name: current_max
field.doc: Maximum cell current over the same window points; same presence rule as current_min.

field.name: scan_timestamp
field.doc: Acquisition timestamp as recorded by the diffraction instrument.

field.name: midpoint_adjusted_timestamp
field.doc: Timestamp shifted to the middle of the exposure; used for the nearest-neighbour match.

field.name: voltage_timestamp
field.doc: Timestamp of the matched electrochemistry point.

field.name: exposure_time
field.doc: Length of the acquisition in seconds: the exposure the source records for the scan (an EDF ExposureTime header, a .dat ExposureTime line), else the scan window the instrument recorded, end minus start (for Diamond i11-1 the GDA scan window, readout and processing included). end_time is start_time plus this value.

group.name: monitor
group.doc: Beam-monitor counts of this acquisition, from the Monitor counter of its EDF header. Present only when the counter is positive: absent on instruments without a beam monitor and for synchrotron sources. The counting mode and preset are held once in the entry-level monitor.

field.name: integral
field.doc: Total monitor counts of the acquisition.

group.name: data
group.doc: The azimuthally averaged 1D pattern. Required whenever a 1D pattern exists for the acquisition; scans recorded as 2D images only carry an image_source reference (and optionally image_data) instead. Each subentry must hold at least one of data / image_source (not expressible in NXDL; enforced by the writer).

attribute.name: oned_source_file
attribute.doc: Basename of the source azimuthally averaged file.

field.name: polar_angle
field.doc: Scattering angle (two-theta) of the azimuthally averaged pattern.

field.name: data
field.doc: Azimuthally averaged intensities. Relaxed from NXmonopd's NX_INT to NX_NUMBER: these are processed, not raw counts.

field.name: data_errors
field.doc: Propagated intensity uncertainties (Sigma_I) of data, named per the NXdata FIELDNAME_errors convention (the bare errors name is deprecated since NIAC 2018).

group.name: image_source
group.doc: Reference to the raw 2D detector image this pattern was reduced from. Large images are referenced rather than duplicated; a copy, stride-decimated to a display size when the source exceeds it, may be embedded in image_data (original_shape then gives the full size).

field.name: type
field.doc: MIME type of the source, e.g. application/x-hdf5.

field.name: embedded
field.doc: Whether a copy of the image is embedded in image_data.

field.name: original_shape
field.doc: Shape of the original image before downsampling.

group.name: image_data
group.doc: Embedded (possibly downsampled) copy of the 2D detector image.
